description: Same-type signal pairs close enough in embedding space (cosine >= 0.78) to reach the signal_duplicate decision. gold is the relation of LATER to EARLIER (same | earlier_richer | later_richer | overlap | different); also_ok lists defensible alternatives. The damaging error is hiding a signal whose gold is overlap or different (information disappears from the feed and recall); a missed hide only leaves a redundant signal visible. Used by scripts/eval_signal_dedup.py.
